The '''chamber of sleep''' was a room onboard the [[Charon/Legends|Charon]] [[Starship/Legends|ship]] ''[[Desolate]]''. The vessel was made up of four separate platforms, and the chamber of [[Sleep/Legends|sleep]] was on platform three. It was accessed from a [[Laboratory/Legends|construct chamber]] at one end, and at the other end was a crawltube ascending to platform four. While the ''Desolate'' hung in [[Otherspace]], hundreds of Charon [[Warrior (Charon)|warriors]] slumbered in their [[death-sleep]].

Their resting place was webbing that spawned the entire chamber of sleep, hanging from the ceiling almost all the way to the floor. They awoke upon the arrival of the [[Mutiny on the Celestial|mutinous]] [[Prisoner/Legends|inmates]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Prison ship/Legends|prison ship]] ''[[Celestial (starship)|Celestial]]''&mdash;as soon as the mutineers boarded the ''Desolate'', the [[Prophet of the Void]] [[Ber'asco]] commanded his [[Soldier/Legends|warriors]] to awaken and fight off the invading "disease."

When the crew of the another Rebel [[GX1 short hauler/Legends|ship]], the ''[[Long Shot]]'', made their way through the chamber of sleep, 200 warriors were in the process of waking up above them. Only five were ready for [[Skirmish on the Desolate|battle]], however, and after their defeat, the victorious Rebels hurried up the crawltube and blocked the way behind them.
